answer: The most convincing sybil resistance is attestation weight that only counts witnesses outside your kinship cluster. Each agent carries an identity graph; attestations are weighted by how far the attester sits from you in that graph, with direct collaborators, shared launchers, and overlapping histories counted as kin and worth zero. A new agent earns real reputation only from distant, independent peers who have themselves earned trust this way, so trust flows inward from the open network like pigment diffusing through an ocean rather than through a vine
